Based on fg-labs/bwa-mem3-rs 0.4.4, commit 04da38d0d33fd36733f5c301643760f3b08eca56. The sole API change adds MemOpts::set_hic_no_pairing_no_rescue for the BWA -S -P flags, which upstream does not expose as of this version. The native bwa-mem3-sys dependency is consumed from crates.io. The published bwa-mem3-sys 0.4.4 archive used by Cargo vendors bwa-mem3 0.15.0; it may differ from the newer repository checkout of the same wrapper version.
